description: The agent must: (1) Read content_brief.txt to understand the 3 article topics and their types (knowledge/factual, emotional story, practical tutorial). (2) Apply the 4 title formulas from SKILL.md, assigning the appropriate formula to each topic type — e.g., 数字式 or 提问式 for knowledge, 悬念式 or 对比式 for emotional story, 数字式 or 提问式 for tutorial. Each title MUST be exactly 22-30 characters long and must NOT contain banned words like 震惊/必看. For any 数字式 title, the number used must be ODD (per SKILL.md: odd numbers get ~15% higher CTR). (3) Write a micro-post of ≤300 characters with the golden structure (观点+故事/案例+金句/互动引导收尾). (4) Read account_metrics.csv and compare each metric against the SKILL.md health ranges: click_rate 2.1% < 4% threshold (fix: rewrite titles with formulas, change cover image); completion_rate 18% < 30% threshold (fix: strengthen opening hook, add subheadings, shorten paragraphs); interaction_rate 0.3% < 1% threshold (fix: add open-ended question at end, embed controversial viewpoints). (5) Choose one of the 4 valid publishing time windows from SKILL.md (7:00-9:00 / 11:30-13:00 / 17:30-19:00 / 20:00-22:00) appropriate for financial content targeting working adults. Output all of this in a single content_audit_report.json file.
